# S_DE_SIGN — Architecture Studio & Spatial Practice
> Independent architecture studio specializing in modern residential architecture, luxury villas, interior environments, and spatial design.

## Core Services & Disciplines
- https://sdesign.co.in/: Home – studio philosophy, approach, and project showcase.
- https://sdesign.co.in/work/: Architecture portfolio & selected case studies (residential, hospitality, cultural, renovation).
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/: Architectural design services directory.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/residential-architecture: Residential architecture firm & luxury villa design.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/interior-architecture: Interior architecture, spatial curation & bespoke millwork.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/exterior-architecture: Exterior architecture, building envelopes & facade elevation design.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/landscape-architecture: Landscape architecture, reflection pools & courtyard spatial integration.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/commercial-architecture: Commercial architecture, boutique hospitality & design ateliers.
- https://sdesign.co.in/services/renovation-adaptive-reuse: Architectural renovation, historic restoration & adaptive reuse.

## Locations & Service Areas
- Chennai, India (Primary Regional Studio & Area Served)
- Lisbon, Portugal & Worldwide (International Spatial Practice)
